source.reference: PHQ-M-19-1417-A, 18 June 1942, printed p.2 section 6 climb table; cover specifies R-2800-21 with torque meter
source.inspection: Original cover and printed page 2 pixels inspected. Table BHP preserved literally; no claim of pointwise torque calibration uncertainty or atmosphere correction.

configuration.cooling: cowl, oil cooler and intercooler flaps wide open

mass.qualification: Cover gross weight, not established instantaneous or normalized mass at each climb row.

gearing.source: T.O. 01-65BC-1, preliminary P-47B handbook, 25 April 1942, Section V.1.a, printed p.16, PDF page 18
gearing.inspection: Original PDF page 18 pixels inspected: propeller gear ratio 0.5:1 crankshaft speed. Archived rendered page retains the statement and 2700/2550 engine rating table.

states.sourceLocation: printed p.2 section 6, second 12600-ft row, rated-power transition

policy: No parameters fitted to these rows. Distinct from 41-5931 boost-proxy climb data. Exact nodes include a separate military/normal transition at 12600 ft. No interpolation, power-law extension, or transfer of normalized performance claims. Printed corrected MAP is not used to derive power.
